import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        int r;
        while (b > 0) {
            r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int g = gcd(x, y);
        x /= g;
        y /= g;

        if (n >= y) {
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
            return;
        }

        double target = (double) x / y;
        double bestError = target;
        int[] ans = new int[n];
        int bestDen = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            double h = i * target;
            double low = Math.floor(h);
            double errLow = Math.abs(low / i - target);
            double errHigh = Math.abs((low + 1) / i - target);

            if (bestError > errLow || bestError > errHigh) {
                if (errLow > errHigh) {
                    ans[i - 1] = (int) low + 1;
                    bestDen = i;
                    bestError = errHigh;
                } else {
                    ans[i - 1] = (int) low;
                    bestDen = i;
                    bestError = errLow;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans[bestDen - 1] + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
